channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-10-16 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 306¢/lb — up 5.7% on the week and up 3.3% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 21 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.8σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is watch. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (-1.6%) — a neutral currency backdrop.
